mx.title: Indep y Armenta liberan mil 115 créditos agrarios en Puebla y frenan juicios contra campesinos
mx.description: El gobierno de México liberó este jueves en Puebla mil 115 créditos de la extinta Financiera Nacional de Desarrollo Agropecuario, Rural, Forestal y Pesquero (FNDL) por un monto total de 614 millones de pesos , beneficiando a mujeres y pequeños productores agrícolas que enfrentaban procesos de cobro y registros negativos en el Buró de Crédito. El anuncio fue encabezado por la directora general del Instituto para Devolver al Pueblo lo Robado (Indep), Mónica Fernández Balboa , en compañía del gobernador de Puebla, Alejandro Armenta Mier , durante la presentación del programa federal “Volver a crecer”. La funcionaria federal informó que en el estado se tiene un padrón total de mil 591 acreditados , de los cuales 70 por ciento obtuvo su liquidación definitiva mediante la carta de finiquito, mientras que para las 476 personas restantes se activó un esquema de reestructuración que contempla 30 por ciento de descuento sobre el saldo final . Durante su intervención, la titular del Indep puntualizó los alcances jurídicos del programa, destacando la suspensión total de demandas y juicios mercantiles contra los deudores . “En Puebla hay mil 591 personas entre hombres y mujeres que tienen créditos con la Financiera. Hemos liberado mil 115 y a los más de 400 que quedan les estamos ofreciendo un nuevo esquema con el 30 por ciento de descuento”, informó. Fernández Balboa expuso que la tarde de este jueves el gobierno federal y estatal están haciendo el desistimiento de la acción legal y, por lo tanto, “ninguno de esos juicios que están atrás de ustedes va a seguir prosperando”. En ese sentido, afirmó, “ ya están fuera del Buró de Crédito y pueden ser sujetos de nuevos financiamientos ”. Destacó que los beneficiarios podrán recuperar las escrituras, facturas o títulos de propiedad dejados en garantía prendaria e hipotecaria, además de advertir que todos los trámites son gratuitos, personales y sin intermediarios en las sedes habilitadas en la entidad. Eran cargas impagables por intereses moratorios: Armenta Por su parte, el gobernador Alejandro Armenta Mier reconoció la sensibilidad del Gobierno Federal encabezado por la presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo, al señalar que los créditos del campo se habían convertido en cargas impagables por el cobro desmedido de intereses moratorios. “Sin duda, el campo requiere inversión; ustedes tocaron la puerta, buscaron ese recurso para financiar un proyecto productivo y dejaron en garantía su título de propiedad, su casa o la factura de un tractor. Saberse con un adeudo que impedía tener acceso a financiamiento era una preocupación de años. A veces el interés multiplica el monto de la suerte principal y se vuelve una deuda impagable. Este programa es el reflejo del humanismo mexicano”, expresó el mandatario estatal. La Financiera Nacional de Desarrollo fue extinguida por decreto federal tras acumular una cartera vencida crítica y esquemas de cobranza judicial que afectaron a miles de familias rurales. A nivel nacional, el programa “Volver a crecer” contempla la liberación de más de 42 mil créditos agrícolas , permitiendo a los productores reinsertarse al sistema financiero formal a través de instituciones públicas como FIRA, Financiera para el Bienestar ( Finabien ) y el Banco del Bienestar. Health workers and other frontline workers in the Ebola response are being prioritized to receive the Ervebo vaccine that was effective in past Ebola outbreaks caused by a different, more common type. Clinical trials are going on to find a licensed vaccine for the current outbreak. "We have decided to use the Ervebo vaccine to protect first those who are on the front line," Health Minister Roger Kamba said at the launch of the vaccination campaign in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo, which is one of the six provinces affected by Ebola in the east. As of Tuesday, the country had recorded 5,713 confirmed cases, including 2,744 deaths, according to government figures. It is concentrated in Ituri province and is known to be the deadliest of all past 17 Ebola outbreaks in the country. The outbreak is spreading under extremely difficult conditions, fueled by insecurity, displacement, a health workers' strike and intense population movements. The World Health Organization has said it remains out of control and is on track to surpass the 2014-2016 West Africa Ebola outbreak, the deadliest on record, which killed more than 11,000 people, primarily in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone. More than 50,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine have been received, according to Congo's state news agency. The World Health Organization said last week that 70,000 doses of Ervebo had been approved for use in Congo. About 50,000 doses are intended for frontline and health workers, while 20,000 doses will be used in a clinical trial to study whether the vaccine protects against Bundibugyo virus, which is causing the current outbreak and has no licensed vaccine nor treatment. The vaccine is being used under a compassionate-use program, which allows a medical product to be used in a serious disease situation even though it has not been specifically approved for that particular use. Health authorities said Ervebo could offer some protection against the Bundibugyo virus because the two viruses are related. But whether the vaccine can actually prevent illness in people infected with Bundibugyo Ebola is still being studied. Placide Mbala Kingebeni, Africa CDC's director for research, clinical trials and innovation, said data will be collected during the vaccination campaign to measure how well the vaccine works. The campaign is expected to cover 14 health zones in Tshopo, Bas-Uele and Haut-Uele provinces. Kamba strongly encouraged health workers to get vaccinated, saying the vaccine could protect them from the disease and help prevent them from carrying the virus into their communities.

pk.title: Afghanistan: Weekly Market Report: Issue 309: Week 4 - August 2026
pk.description: Country: Afghanistan Source: World Food Programme Please refer to the attached file. Key Highlights Market Overview Market conditions remained broadly stable during the fourth week of August, although price movements varied across food commodities, vegetables, fuel, and agricultural inputs. Most staple food prices changed only marginally, while vegetable prices declined. At the same time, diesel and fertilizer prices remained elevated, sustaining pressure on transportation and agricultural production costs. Overall commodity availability remained adequate, although regional trade conditions and higher fuel and input costs continued to weigh on market stability. Food Items: • National food prices remained relatively stable during the fourth week of August, with most staple commodities recording only modest weekly changes. However, several food items continued to trade above last year's levels, particularly rice, wheat, cooking oil, and potato. • Wheat and Wheat Flour: Wheat grain and flour prices experienced negligible changes during the week. Compared with last year, wheat grain and low-price wheat flour remained 14% and 12% higher, respectively. • Rice: The prices of rice categories showed mixed movements, with high-price Palawi rice declining slightly by 0.3%, while low-price Sholae rice increased by 1.2%. However, both varieties remained substantially above last year's levels, at 25% and 36% higher, respectively, and well above their three-year averages. • Other Staples: Cooking oil and sugar prices increased by 0.6% and 0.8%, respectively, while pulses and salt declined slightly and bread prices remained unchanged. Year-on-year trends remained mixed, with cooking oil and sugar prices 11% and 8% higher, respectively, while pulses and bread were 14% and 3% lower than last year. • Vegetables: Vegetable prices continued to show divergent trends. Tomato, onion and potato prices fell by 4.6%, 2.2% and 0.7%, respectively. Despite the weekly declines, potato prices remained 50% higher than last year, while tomato and onion prices remain near to last year’s levels. Non-Food Items: • Exchange Rate: The Afghani strengthened slightly to AFN 64.8/USD, appreciating by 0.6% week-on-week. It remained 5% stronger than last year and 13% stronger than the three-year average, continuing to provide some support in containing imported commodity costs. • Fuel: Diesel prices continued its upward trend and increased by 1.2% during the week to AFN 78.0 per litre. Prices are 17% higher than the same time last year and 20% above the three-year average, maintaining upward pressure on transportation and supply-chain costs. • Fertilizers: Fertilizer prices showed mix movements during the week, with DAP increasing by 0.4% while urea declined by 1.2%. However, fertilizer prices stand considerably above last year's levels, with DAP and urea prices 15% and 30% higher, respectively, continuing to raise production costs for farmers. • Terms of Trade (ToT): The ToT, which reflects the purchasing power, remained under pressure for both labourdependent households and pastoralists during the fourth week of August. Nominal casual labour ToT declined by 0.8% week-on-week to 10.4 kg of wheat flour and remained 14% below last year, while unskilled labour availability fell by 2.8% to 2.0 days per week, remaining 16% below both last year and the three-year average. Similarly, pastoralist ToT declined by 0.7% week-on-week and 16% year-on-year, reflecting continued weakness in the purchasing power of livestock keepers.

ae.title: UAE Ministry of Education announces reduced school hours in the first week, with full attendance from September 4
ae.description: Dubai: Details of the plan for the gradual return of students at various educational levels to schools during the first week of the new academic year 2026-2027, adopted by the Ministry of Education and circulated by schools to parents, revealed two scenarios for the return of students. Students’ attendance will be reduced from Monday to Thursday, so that the number of hours during the first week of school will be reduced by three hours and 15 minutes for kindergartens, four hours for the first cycle and five for the second and third cycles, while Friday will see full attendance. Starting Monday, August 31, 2026, schools in Dubai and the Northern Emirates will begin implementing the plan, which will continue for four days, until Thursday, September 3. All students will be attending full-time classes on Friday, September 4. The School Operations Sector in Dubai and the Northern Emirates prepared the plan to ensure an organised and safe return for students and the continuity of the educational process, leading to full attendance at school, while giving schools flexibility in determining the days for student attendance during the gradual return period, according to their readiness and needs. The plan is based on three main pillars: a gradual return of students from Monday to Thursday according to attendance days determined by each school, the application of reduced attendance during these days, and then the transition to full attendance for all students on Friday, September 4. Two scenarios for organising attendance The plan outlines two timelines for the gradual return of students, allowing schools to choose the most suitable arrangement based on their readiness and needs. It also emphasises the necessity of coordinating with the school transport provider to prevent any scheduling conflicts. Furthermore, it grants school, kindergarten, and educational complex administrators the flexibility to adjust the return schedule and increase the number of days students are present as needed. Scenario one The first scenario divides the attendance of students in school classes over the days from Monday to Thursday, so that each class attends only one day during the gradual return period, while all students return to school on Friday. According to the schedule, first-grade students will attend on Monday, August 31, second-grade students on Tuesday, third-grade students on Wednesday, and fourth-grade students on Thursday. In the second cycle, fifth-grade students will attend on Monday, sixth-grade students on Tuesday, seventh-grade students on Wednesday, and eighth-grade students on Thursday. As for the third round, ninth-grade students attend on Monday, the tenth grade on Tuesday, the eleventh grade on Wednesday, and the twelfth grade on Thursday. In the kindergarten or primary school category, first-grade students attend on Mondays and Tuesdays, and second-grade students attend on Wednesdays and Thursdays, before all students return on Friday, September 4. Scenario two The second scenario allows for an increase in student attendance days during the gradual period, with students in some classes attending two days instead of one. In the first cycle, the first grade attends on Monday and Tuesday, the second grade on Tuesday and Wednesday, the third grade on Wednesday and Thursday, and the fourth grade on Wednesday and Thursday. In the second cycle, the fifth grade attends on Monday and Tuesday, the sixth grade on Tuesday and Wednesday, the seventh grade on Wednesday and Thursday, and the eighth grade on Wednesday and Thursday. As for the third cycle, the ninth grade attends on Monday and Tuesday, the tenth grade on Tuesday and Wednesday, the eleventh grade on Wednesday and Thursday, and the twelfth grade on Wednesday and Thursday. Kindergartens will continue according to the same distribution in both scenarios, with kindergarten students attending on Monday and Tuesday, and kindergarten students attending on Wednesday and Thursday, with all students attending full-time on Friday. Reduced working hours The Ministry outlined the school hours during the gradual return period in its guidelines, noting that these hours vary according to the educational stage. For kindergartens, the reduced school day begins at 8.15a.m. and ends at 11.30a.m., totalling 3 hours and 15 minutes. In the first episode, the plan specified two options: the first from 7.15am to 11.15am, and the second from 8:15am to 12.15pm, with four hours in both options. As for the male students in the second and third cycles, their school day starts from 7.15am to 12.15pm, for a total of five hours, while the school day for the female students in the second and third cycles starts from 8.15am to 1.15pm, for a total of five hours, as well. On Friday, September 4, with the transition to full-time schooling, kindergarten hours will be from 8am to 11.30am, while the first cycle hours will be according to the first option from 7.10am to 10.30am, or according to the second option from 8am to 11.30am. The school hours for male students in the second and third cycles are from 7.10am to 10.25am, while the school hours for female students are from 8am to 11.30am. Measuring and reporting on family and student satisfaction The plan does not end with the end of the gradual return days, as it includes a phase to measure the results of the campaign to welcome students and return to schools, by measuring parents’ satisfaction with the campaign, conducting a survey of students’ opinions and benefiting from the feedback provided by them. The plan also requires schools to fill out all forms approved by the Ministry, and to submit reports on the activities carried out by each school during the return period. Thus, the plan places the return to school for the academic year 2026-2027 within a gradual, flexible and multi-track framework, starting with reduced attendance distributed across classes over four days, with more than one mechanism available to organise attendance days. It is not limited to the academic aspect, but extends to the readiness of buildings and facilities, school transportation, security and safety, receiving new students, activities, communication with families, and finally measuring the satisfaction of students and parents and evaluating the return experience. Schools retain the flexibility to rearrange the return schedule and increase student attendance days to suit their readiness and needs, provided they coordinate with the transportation service provider to prevent scheduling conflicts between shared buses, before transitioning to the full return of all students to in-person classes on Friday, September 4, 2026.

ae.description: Across the entire history of the S&P 500, just nine companies have ever posted a quarter with revenue of $100 billion or more. Nvidia has now told investors it plans to sail past that mark next quarter, and not narrowly. Guidance came in at $108 billion, against analyst models of $103.9 billion. That figure, not the quarter Nvidia just wrapped, is the real news in the company's fiscal second-quarter report. The closed quarter was, measured against the bar this company keeps raising for itself, unremarkable. Revenue landed at $96.2 billion where consensus sat at $92.27 billion. Earnings per share came in at $2.22 against $2.09 expected. Two beats, nothing to linger on. The data center number is the whole story Data center brought in $89 billion. Analysts had penciled in $85.4 billion. Run the numbers and that single segment represents something like 92% of Nvidia's sales for the quarter. Gaming, automotive and professional visualization all have to squeeze into what's left. What you're looking at is an AI infrastructure business with a handful of side projects attached. CEO Jensen Huang stuck to the framing he's leaned on for months. "AI has reached its inflection point," Huang said. "Now compute is revenue ... And demand is accelerating." Treat that as an executive playing his part on an earnings call if you like. It also happens to describe the trajectory of the data center line, which has climbed beyond anything a single customer or product refresh could account for. Margins are going the wrong way, slightly Now for the detail that stayed out of the press release headline. Nvidia's gross margin guidance for next quarter is 74%, a step down from the 75% it posted in Q2. A single point. Minor enough to dismiss when the top line is compounding at this rate. Yet the direction of a margin tells you more than its level when the question is whether a company still commands pricing power or has begun paying up to defend its ground. Keep an eye on that figure over the next two or three quarters. No cheaper signal exists. The market shrugged The stock drifted slightly lower once the after-hours session opened. Revenue beat, earnings beat, guidance ahead of consensus — and shares slipped anyway. NVDA finished the session at $207.78. Anchor to that when you interpret the after-hours move, since the response to a beat reveals far more about what investors had already baked in than the beat does on its own. By this stage, expectations are carrying most of the weight. Crypto barely blinked Bitcoin stayed in a tight range a little above $78,000 while the results crossed the wire. What makes that notable is mainly the absence of a reaction. There was a period when Nvidia's results and crypto prices swung together, back when GPUs and mining rigs competed for the same supply chain. That connection has frayed badly, and this quarter makes the case nicely: the cycle's largest AI hardware print dropped and bitcoin never left its band. What the $108 billion actually means Nvidia didn't stumble into a headline-friendly figure, but it isn't engineering one either. Nine companies in the index's history have ever broken $100 billion in a quarter. Nvidia's guidance sits $8 billion beyond that line. The $4.1 billion spread between guidance and consensus exceeds the entire quarterly revenue of most listed companies on its own. That's the scale in play now — and precisely why one point of gross margin compression is the more revealing number in the release. What to actually watch Whether you follow the stock itself or treat AI infrastructure spending as a read on the wider sector, set the beat aside. Beats have been the assumed floor here for eight straight quarters. Follow two things instead: whether data center revenue continues to outrun the guidance Nvidia sets for it, and whether that 74% gross margin steadies or keeps drifting down. The first shows demand still running ahead of what management is willing to promise in public. The second shows what meeting that demand actually costs. Every other line in the report is noise around those two.

sa.title: التحول الصحي.. امنحوه فرصته
sa.description: بدأت عملي ممارسا صحيا عام 1999، وعشت تفاصيل القطاع عن قرب، ولذلك أستطيع القول إن ما أراه اليوم يختلف جذريا عما عرفناه في السابق. لم يتغير شكل الخدمة فقط، وإنما تغيرت طريقة التفكير فيها، وأصبح التركيز أكبر على الوقاية وجودة الحياة والوصول إلى المريض قبل أن تتفاقم حالته. وأدرك تماما أن الممارس الصحي، وحتى المواطن العادي، قد يتخوف من التغيير بشكل عام، خصوصا إذا كان يمس عمله أو صحته أو طريقة حصوله على العلاج. فالإنسان بطبيعته يرتاح لما اعتاده، ويقلق من كل مرحلة لم تتضح تفاصيلها بعد. وهذا ما يحدث اليوم مع التحول الصحي في المملكة. هناك من يتساءل عن مستقبل الخدمات، ومن يشعر أن الإجراءات تغيرت، ومن يقارن تجربته الحالية بما كان يحصل عليه سابقا. هذه المخاوف لا ينبغي التقليل منها، لكنها أيضا لا تعني أن نحكم على التحول قبل اكتمال مراحله. القطاع الصحي لا يشهد تعديلات محدودة، وإنما يعاد بناؤه بما ينسجم مع مستهدفات رؤية البلاد 2030. والهدف هو الانتقال من التركيز على علاج المرض بعد وقوعه إلى الاهتمام بصحة الإنسان قبل أن يمرض، مع رفع جودة الخدمة، وتسهيل الوصول إليها، والاستفادة من التقنية والبيانات، وتحسين كفاءة الإنفاق. لسنوات طويلة، تعودنا أن تبدأ علاقتنا بالصحة عند باب المستشفى. نشعر بألم، فنطلب موعدا لدى طبيب متخصص، ثم نجري الفحوصات ونحصل على الدواء. أما النموذج الجديد فيعطي مساحة أكبر للرعاية الأولية والوقاية والكشف المبكر ومتابعة الأمراض المزمنة. وهذه ثقافة تحتاج إلى وقت حتى تصبح مألوفة لدى المجتمع. قد لا يحتاج المريض إلى مستشفى كبير في كل مرة، ولا حتى الوقوف أمام بوابات الطوارئ، فقد تكون حالته قابلة للعلاج في مركز صحي قريب من المنزل أو من خلال استشارة عن بعد. كما أن أقسام الطوارئ يجب أن تبقى للحالات الطارئة، والمنقذة للحياة، لا أن تصبح بديلا عن العيادات بسبب سهولة الوصول إليها. تنظيم هذه المسارات ليس تقليلا من الخدمة، وإنما محاولة لإيصال كل مريض إلى المكان الذي يناسب حالته. الدول التي سبقتنا في تطوير أنظمتها الصحية لم تنجز ذلك خلال سنوات قليلة. استغرقت تجاربها وقتا طويلا، ومرت بمراحل من التعديل والتقييم، ومازالت تواجه مشكلات في المواعيد والتكاليف والانتظار ونقص بعض التخصصات. لذلك ليس واقعيا أن نتوقع تحولا بهذا الحجم من دون صعوبات أو أخطاء في بدايته. لكن تفهم المرحلة لا يعني تبرير القصور. إذا تعطل موعد مريض، أو لم يجد دواءه، أو ضاع بين الجهات، فهذه مشكلة يجب الاعتراف بها ومعالجتها. ومن حق المواطن أن ينتقد ويشتكي ويطالب بخدمة تليق به. المطلوب أن يكون حكمنا على التجربة منصفا، فلا نعمم خطأ واحدا على مشروع كامل، ولا نتجاهل خللا يتكرر بحجة أن التحول يحتاج إلى وقت. الجهات الصحية مطالبة كذلك أن تتحدث مع الناس بوضوح. المواطن لا تعنيه كثيرا المسميات الإدارية أو تبعية المنشأة، وإنما يريد أن يعرف إلى أين يذهب، وكيف يحجز موعده، ومن يتابع علاجه، وأين يجد دواءه. وكل إجراء لا يشرح للمستفيد بصورة واضحة سيتحول إلى حيرة وقلق، مهما كانت أهدافه جيدة. أما المواطن فليس بعيدا عن هذه المسؤولية. من يحجز موعدا ولا يحضره يحرم مريضا آخر منه، ومن يذهب إلى الطوارئ بسبب حالة بسيطة يزيد الضغط على من يحتاج إلى تدخل عاجل. كما أن إهمال الفحوصات والدواء والغذاء والنشاط البدني يجعل علاج الأمراض أصعب وأكثر تكلفة. ولا يجوز أن نحمل المواطن مسؤولية كل شيء. توفير الخدمة وجودتها وسهولة الوصول إليها مسؤولية الجهات الصحية أولا، لكن المحافظة على الصحة مسؤولية شخصية أيضا. لا يمكن لأي نظام صحي أن يحقق أهدافه إذا بقي الإنسان ينتظر ظهور المرض حتى يبدأ الاهتمام بنفسه. وسيكون الحكم الحقيقي على التحول من خلال ما يلمسه المريض، لا من خلال عدد البرامج والمبادرات. هل أصبح الوصول إلى الموعد أسهل؟ هل وجد المريض من يتابع حالته؟ هل حصل على العلاج والدواء في الوقت المناسب؟ وهل شعر أن كرامته ووقته محل تقدير؟ هذه هي الأسئلة التي تهم الناس، وهي التي ستحدد مستوى ثقتهم في التحول. نحن أمام مشروع وطني كبير، ومن الطبيعي أن يحتاج إلى وقت حتى تستقر إجراءاته وتظهر نتائجه. وما يحدث اليوم لم يعد خيارا يمكن تأجيله، وإنما ضرورة تفرضها متغيرات العصر، وتزايد الاحتياجات الصحية، وانتشار الأمراض المزمنة، وارتفاع تكلفة العلاج. المطلوب أن نستوعب اتجاه هذا التحول، وأن نمنحه فرصته، وأن نشارك في تحسينه بالملاحظات الصادقة والنقد المسؤول، من دون مقاومة كل جديد لمجرد أنه مختلف، ومن دون القبول بكل شيء من دون مراجعة. التحول الصحي لن ينجح بالقرارات والتقنيات وحدها. نجاحه يحتاج إلى جهة تشرح وتنفذ وتحاسب، وممارس صحي يؤمن بدوره، ومواطن يعرف حقوقه ويتحمل مسؤوليته. وفي النهاية، الغاية ليست تغيير شكل القطاع الصحي، وإنما بناء منظومة تحفظ صحة الإنسان وتصل إليه قبل أن يصل إليها مريضا.

mg.title: STADE BAREA - L’enquête parlementaire en cours
mg.description: Les budgets alloués à la rénovation du stade Barea au centre de l’enquête parlementaire. Rien n’est officiel. La déclaration du président de l’Assemblée nationale, Siteny Thierry Randrianasoloniaiko, du mardi sur les budgets alloués à la rénovation du stade Barea à Mahamasina, durant les exercices du régime Andry Rajoelina de 2019 à 2025, «s’élevait plutôt à 120 millions de dollars contre 77 millions de dollars, ce qui était annoncé auparavant», a fait un «grand boom». Le numéro un de la chambre basse a précisé que malgré cet investissement pharaonique, « le stade n’a pas jusqu’ici obtenu l’homologation définitive ». Le président de la commission sur l’enquête parlementaire, Sylvestre Mahavitara, a affirmé hier que « l’enquête est encore en cours. La commission communiquera les rapports officiels de l’enquête. Nous sommes en ce moment en train de collecter les documents nécessaires pour l’enquête ». Vérification des documents Le président de la commission d’enquête parlementaire a ajouté que « Nous sommes en train de vérifier les dossiers techniques. Nous avons recueilli ce jour (hier) tous les documents avec les institutions et organismes publics en charge de l’enquête comme le Bianco, Arai, Samfin, PRMP, CNM et le ministère de l’Économie et des Finances (...) Nous verrons ultérieurement son évolution ». Les procédures d’appel d’offres ainsi que des marchés publics seront certainement au cœur de l’enquête. «Tous les citoyens ont le droit de savoir la vérité sur cette affaire (...) et il ne s’agit uniquement pas de l’affaire stade Barea mais tant d’autres sur les projets présidentiels. Nous avons plusieurs sources et nous enverrons les résultats et les rapports de l’enquête aux autorités compétentes. L’enquête devrait selon le texte durer six mois mais nous essayerons de la boucler en quatre mois. L’enquête se déroule à merveille grâce aux aides des organes de contrôle», a souligné le président de la commission d’enquête parlementaire. Serge Rasanda

mg.title: SANTÉ INFANTILE - Les enfants accèdent aux soins pédiatriques
mg.description: L’appareil utilisé pour réaliser les échographies pédiatriques. Vingt-cinq enfants pourront bénéficier gratuitement d’une échographie pédiatrique ce dimanche 30 août. L’initiative sera organisée par l’Institut Médical de Madagascar dans le cadre de sa nouvelle action de santé communautaire. Destinée aux enfants âgés de 0 à 12 ans, cette première édition de « Un Dimanche pour la Vie » débutera à 8 heures. Elle vise notamment les familles qui renoncent parfois à certains examens médicaux en raison de leurs difficultés financières. Ordonnance Les parents souhaitant inscrire leur enfant peuvent appeler gratuitement le Numéro Vert 617 ou se rendre directement au guichet de l’établissement. Une ordonnance médicale est requise pour bénéficier de l’examen. Pour cette journée, un circuit spécifique sera aménagé afin de séparer les bénéficiaires du service des urgences et de faciliter leur prise en charge. Une équipe médicale assurera également l’accompagnement des familles tout au long du parcours. Cette action devrait être reconduite chaque mois. À travers ce dispositif, l’établissement souhaite contribuer à réduire les obstacles financiers qui peuvent retarder l’accès des enfants aux examens spécialisés. Pour cette première opération, seules vingt-cinq places sont prévues. Les familles intéressées sont donc invitées à effectuer leur inscription à l’avance. Fanilo Mampianintsoa

mg.title: COUPURE DE COURANT - Les petits commerces misent sur les groupes électrogènes
mg.description: La soudure fait partie des activités qui dépendent fortement de l’électricité. Depuis des années, le délestage fait partie du quotidien. Pour les petits commerces dont l’activité dépend de l’électricité, attendre le retour du courant n’est plus une solution. Cybercafés, salons de coiffure et autres commerces s’équipent ainsi de groupes électrogènes pour poursuivre leurs activités. « L’électricité est indispensable au fonctionnement de nos équipements. Nous ne pouvons donc pas attendre son retour pour continuer à travailler », témoigne Fanja, propriétaire d’un cybercafé. Dans plusieurs quartiers, des affiches annoncent même la continuité du service malgré le délestage. « Nous travaillons même en cas de délestage », peut-on lire devant certains commerces. L’objectif est de maintenir l’activité et de ne pas perdre les clients pendant les coupures. Mais cette adaptation a un coût. En plus de la facture d’électricité, les commerçants doivent prévoir le carburant nécessaire au fonctionnement de leur groupe. « Nous pouvons consommer environ cinq litres de gazole pour deux heures », explique Fanja. La consommation dépend toutefois de la puissance et du type de groupe utilisé. Pour ces petits commerces, le groupe électrogène est devenu un moyen de ne pas interrompre leur activité. Une solution qui permet de continuer à travailler malgré les coupures, mais qui alourdit aussi les dépenses quotidiennes. Fanilo Mampianintsoa

cm.title: Le Cameroun recherche 150 milliards de F pour construire un pipeline et un dépôt pétrolier à Kribi
cm.description: © DR Une rencontre entre les porteurs de projet et les investisseurs a eu lieu le 26 août dernier à Douala avec pour ambition de faire avancer le projet. Pour doter la ville portuaire de Kribi d'un dépôt pétrolier et d'un pipeline, le Cameroun se lance à la recherche des partenaires pouvant financer le projet. C'est dans cette optique que la Société camerounaise des dépôts pétroliers a organisé mercredi une rencontre avec les investisseurs et financiers. Le but de la rencontre est de mobiliser les fonds en vue de la construction dudit dépôt pétrolier. Le coût du projet est évalué à 150 milliards de francs CFA. En vue de mobiliser ces fonds, les démarches sont menées par des cabinets PG & Partners ainsi que la banque ivoirienne Matha Capital. Bien engagé en vue de la réalisation de ce projet, le Cameroun a déjà posé certains actes dont la création d'une ligne dans la structure des prix des produits pétroliers en perspective du financement. L'autre action dans ce sens est la mise en place le 17 août dernier des organes sociaux du dépôt pétrolier de Kribi. À la direction du dépôt pétrolier se trouve Patrice Entame Etame, tandis que Véronique Moampea Mbio, directrice générale de la SCDP, assure la présidence du conseil d'administration. Les financements recherchés permettront de réaliser un projet qui contribuera à réduire la dépendance au Port de Douala, d'accueillir des navires plus grands, d'accélérer le changement et réduire les délais de traitement, renforcer le stockage national, peut-on lire dans une publication de la SCDP en date du 26 août 2026. La rencontre de mercredi s'est tenue à la suite de l'inauguration le 21 août dernier à Douala de trois nouvelles infrastructures dont une nouvelle sphère à gaz domestique à Bonaberi, un nouveau pipeline et un nouveau siège pour la SCDP. La structure est ainsi dans la dynamique de d'améliorer l'approvisionnement en gaz et en carburants au Cameroun dans un contexte où des signaux de pénuries sont d temps en temps donnes à travers la rareté du gaz domestique ou encore du pétrole lampant. Cet article Le Cameroun recherche 150 milliards de F pour construire un pipeline et un dépôt pétrolier à Kribi est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
